blocks.title: Serverless architecture
blocks.text: Serverless architectures developers ko servers sambhale baghair applications banane aur chalane deti hain: cloud provider zaroorat ke mutabiq wasail khud deta hai, aur developers sirf asal istemal shuda computing ki qeemat dete hain.

AWS Lambda baghair servers tayyar ya sambhale code chalata hai, to developers code likhne par tawajjo dete hain. Serverless applications talab ke saath khud barhti hain, to aap sirf zaroorat jitna istemal aur ada karte hain (Amazing Fact). Servers phir bhi hote hain; provider unhein sambhalta hai.

blocks.prompt: Kaunsa model developers ko servers sambhale baghair apps banane aur deploy karne deta hai (MCQ 9)? Is ka bunyadi faida kya hai (MCQ 11)?
Serverless architectures, developers ke liye un ke faide aur application development par asar bataiye (short questions 4 aur 7; long question 5).
blocks.explanation: Serverless computing mein developer chhote functions upload karta aur provider unhein kisi waqia, jaise web request ya file upload, par chalata hai. Faide: servers set, update ya barhane ki zaroorat nahi; sifar se bhari bojh tak khud-kaar tausee; sirf code chalne ke waqt ki adaigi; tez development aur release. Asar: teams chhote waqia par chalne wale functions se apps banati aur mehnat infrastructure ki bajaye features par lagati hain. Shuru hone ki chhoti der aur ek provider par inhisar jaisi hadein aam ilm hain.

items: Serverless: servers ka intezam nahi, khud-kaar tausee, istemal par adaigi (AWS Lambda).
